dc:commonwealth:x346fm32m.note: The Spanish runs two noun phrases together with no punctuation between them. The translator read them as one compound and capitalised mid-phrase, giving Municipal Aqueduct purification plant; they are two things, the aqueduct and its purification plant.
dc:commonwealth:x346fm32m.title: Municipal aqueduct, purification plant, Cali, Colombia
dc:commonwealth:x346fm32m.was: Acueducto municipal planta de purificacion, Cali, Colombia

dc:commonwealth:x346fv13v.note: Half-translated: the first clause was left in Spanish and only the second rendered, and rendered wrongly. Al Norte de la Republica places the subject in the north of Mexico; it does not mean north of it.
dc:commonwealth:x346fv13v.title: The border customs house, Ciudad Juarez. In the north of the Republic
dc:commonwealth:x346fv13v.was: La aduana fronteriza, Ciudad Juarez. Al Norte de la Republica

graz:o:gm.4093.note: Two German words survived into the English. Von was left capitalised as though it were part of a name, and geg. is an abbreviation of gegen, towards -- so geg. Westen is looking west, not the bare word West.
graz:o:gm.4093.title: Old Graz, from the Schlossberg looking west, 1865, by Reichert
graz:o:gm.4093.was: Alt-Graz Von Schlossberg geg. Westen 1865 v. Reichert

loc:2020760634.note: Italian, but detected as Catalan, so a Catalan model ran over it and translated only the article: una became A and fontana was left alone. Fontana is Italian for fountain.
loc:2020760634.title: Eritrea - A fountain

loc:2025707304.note: Three faults at once. The cathedral's name and the century were left in French; pourtour du choeur is the sculpted screen enclosing the choir, not Around the Choir; and the second panel was dropped altogether -- Visite de la Sainte Vierge a Sainte Elisabeth is the Visitation.
loc:2025707304.title: Chartres Cathedral. The choir screen (16th century). "The Annunciation", "The Visitation"
loc:2025707304.was: Cathedrale de Chartres. Pourtour du Choeur (XVIe siecle). "L'Annonciation", "Visite de la Sainte Vierge a Sainte Elisabeth"

loc:2025708744.note: The translator turned 17e into 17th, dropped an article, and left the rest in French -- a caption that looks translated and is not. 17e is the arrondissement, not a date or an ordinal on its own, so it needs the word. Rue Demours is a street and Le Grand Veneur -- the royal Master of the Hunt -- is the restaurant's name; neither is vocabulary.
loc:2025708744.title: Paris (17th arrondissement), rue Demours, the Restaurant du Grand Veneur
loc:2025708744.was: Paris (17e), la rue Demours, Le Restaurant du Grand Veneur

loc:2025713878.note: French detected as Dutch, which turns one word inside out: en is in in French and and in Dutch, so a date became a conjunction. Theodore Steeg arrived as Resident-General of Morocco in 1925.
loc:2025713878.title: Rabat, the arrival of Monsieur Steeg in 1925
loc:2025713878.was: Rabat, Arrivee de M. Steeg en 1925

loc:2025713908.note: The caption is French but was detected as German, so a German model was run over French text and indigenes came back as Indigenouss, a word in no language. This is the museum in the Kasbah of the Oudaias at Rabat; indigenes is the colonial-era French for indigenous, which the museum's own name used.
loc:2025713908.title: Rabat - Museum of Indigenous Arts of the Oudaias
loc:2025713908.was: Rabat - Musee des Arts indigenes des Oudaias

loc:2025716276.note: A bilingual caption saying the same thing in French and German. The French half was translated, the German half left in German, and a letter lost from Brucke on the way.
loc:2025716276.title: Constantinople. The Galata Bridge -- the new bridge
loc:2025716276.was: Constantinople. Le Pont de Galata. Die neue brucke
